regime_context: The detector shows a cyclical-technology leadership structure: Memory/HBM & Storage ranks #1 (eligible, trend-tagged, not crowded) with Non-AI Software and Cybersecurity as crowded, trend-tagged runners-up. Breadth of rotation is 'narrowing' with 24/49 themes eligible and absorption at 0.30 — leadership is consolidating, not broad. The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market, so eligible/trend-tagged themes are the credible stay-in set, but cross-sectional rank itself has no forward edge.
emerging_watch: Watching the Consumer Discretionary candidate radar cluster (tickers ADNT, ALV, BWA, DCH, GNTX, LEA, PHIN, VC; cohesion 0.547, rising 0.159) for evidence of a broadening cyclical rotation into autos/suppliers. This retires as a watch if cross-sector cohesion fails to keep rising or if none of these names confirm with an eligible trend-tag on the next detector run.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The #1 rank with a trend-tagged Hurst, eligible under the absolute-trend gate, and not crowded is the cleanest stay-with-leadership expression. The trend gate is the one validated leg, and this theme sits inside it. Rank-IC is ~0, so this is an attention/focus read, not an alpha claim.
theses.dissent: The headline itself flags val_state=diverging and r10=-0.1588, meaning recent momentum is rolling over even as the durable score stays high — this could be leadership that is quietly distributing. Breadth=0.0 means the leadership is narrow, a single-name or few-name move, not a broad theme.

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Rank #2 and eligible with a trend tag, but crowded=true at z=1.39. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade or sell — an underweight tilt toward this theme relative to the less-crowded leader is the honest, non-short expression of that caution.
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge — it does not predict drawdown or underperformance at the theme level, only down-sizes. A crowded trend can persist for a long time via reflexivity without breaking.

falsifier.text: IGV outpaces SMH by 5% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Highest crowding in the eligible trend set (z=1.65) despite a durable trend tag and rank #3. Same structural logic as Non-AI Software: a caution-driven tilt rather than a fade. Nothing in the state argues for active promotion of this theme over the leader.
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity has the highest durability_bar (0.68) in the eligible trend set — the trend stamina signal is genuinely strong. If the crowding flag is a false alarm (and it has no forward edge), this theme could continue leading.

falsifier.text: CIBR beats SMH by 5% over the next 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
